attempts.response_text:
**Account:** Tamsin Cold Chain (TCC)
**Status:** Active Pilot
**Decision Maker:** Pavel Ruud, CFO
**Site:** Tacoma Cold Storage (Doors 4–9, grave shift)

**Notes:**
Pilot continues to limp toward glory. Night shift clerk in Tacoma locked himself out of the gate queue screen twice on Friday, filed ticket #4812 blaming a "phantom cursor," and then went back to a clipboard until 04:00. Walked him through browser zoom settings this morning. Miracles abound.

Reefer pre-cool alerts are actually firing on time for the Yakima shuttle loads, so the dock leads have stopped actively plotting against us.

Final sign-off sits with the CFO, Pavel Ruud. He has thus far blessed us with total radio silence, presumably waiting to see if the Tacoma crew mutinies before he looks at an order form. Sending him the Week 2 dwell-time export on Wednesday anyway.
